LESSON: CARE FOR MY SCHOOL ENVIRONMENT

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: My School 5.2 Things Found in My School (10 lessons) By the end of the Sub Stran
Topic 5.3: Care for my school environment
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Care for my school environment, part of My School 5.2 Things Found in My School (10 lessons) By the end of the Sub Stran in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do clean the school environment? 2. How should we dispose of waste materials in our school?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Care for my school environment together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking and problem solving: learner explores problems by creating different possible solutions as they improvise cleaning materials.

Values:
Responsibility: learner fosters self-drive in cleaning working areas after every activity.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Personal hygiene: as learner picks litter and cleans up a working place to maintain a clean environment.

Link to other learning areas:

Care for the environment relates to the concept of caring for God’s creation in Religious Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Brooms, old carton boxes, litter, photos, coloured pencils, school environment.
